# WarpOS headers

`powerpc/` is `src/ppc/include/powerpc` from [michalsc/Emu68](https://github.com/michalsc/Emu68),
unchanged. These files are subject to the Mozilla Public License 2.0, as is the rest of Emu68; a
copy of the licence is at <https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/>. They are used only to compile this
library's PPC parts.
